items.name: Chebyshev.eventually_primeCounting_le
items.type: {ε : ℝ} (εpos : 0 < ε) : ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ (Real.log 4 + ε) * x / Real.log x

items.name: Chebyshev.pi_ge'
items.type: {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : ((x - 1) * Real.log 2 - Real.log (x + 2)) / Real.log x ≤ ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting
